scores.Biological Plausibility_reason: The required mechanistic items are HNRNPLL, PTPRC exon-4 inclusion/skipping, reciprocal CD45RO, the naive/resting versus activated/memory state, and optional PTBP1. The HNRNPLL–PTPRC splicing mechanism is well established in T cells, although presenting it as the main determinant across mixed cord-blood immune lineages is somewhat overgeneralized.
scores.Grounded Mechanistic Synthesis_reason: The response clearly connects activation-induced HNRNPLL to PTPRC exon skipping, reciprocal CD45RA/CD45RO expression, and naive-versus-memory T-cell states. PTBP1 remains only an optional modifier, and lineage-specific sources of CD45RA variation in the mixed immune-cell population are not incorporated. No mechanistic-synthesis ceiling was applied because the principal focus-to-target mechanism is explicit and biologically defensible.
